children: Jesse G. Singh, Director, sold 40,000 shares through The Linda S.R. Singh Family Trust on November 24, 2026, at a weighted average price of $28.06 per share. On November 25, he sold 30,000 shares through the trust at a weighted average price of $29.16 per share and directly sold 26,469 shares at $29.06 per share. The total sale amount was $2,766,389. Following the transactions, Singh directly owned 117,772 shares. He indirectly owned 767,829 shares: 263,797 through The Linda S.R. Singh Family Trust, 42,349 through The Jesse G. Singh Revocable Trust, 261,683 through the Jesse Singh 2016 Irrevocable Trust, and 200,000 through The Jesse Singh 2026 GRAT.
